Article 6 (Authorized Number of Military Prosecutors, etc.)
(1) The authorized number of military prosecutors shall be 105.
(2) The ranks and numbers of military prosecutors assigned to the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office and the Military Prosecutors' Offices of each armed service shall be as specified in the attached Table.
